warnings: One combined drawing (แปลนฐานรากและคานรับพื้นชั้น 1) carrying footings, columns, ground-floor beams and slab marks. Split by member kind per section 3 / section 1: footings + columns here (footing_plan), beams and slab marks in _view2_beam_plan.json.
Every column position is printed as a pair 'F1C1' / 'F2C1' / 'F2C2' (footing mark + column mark). F1 = 19 positions, F2 = 32 positions (rows A, C, E, G on grids 2-9).

Grid 11 rows B and F: the F1C1 footing outline is drawn on the row line; the grid-11 line is drawn thickened from row B down 0.90 and from 0.90 above row F (the '.90' dimensions) — the footing is recorded on the row, the thickened segment is not a separate mark.
No grid bubbles are printed for the main building; grid labels 1-11 / A-G were assigned in the grid master.
